name: Behind the Moon, Beyond the Rain
source:
In the not-so-distant future, humanity has been nearly destroyed by a strange disease that infects the hosts and causes them to become mindless, hungry shells.

Two girls join together on a journey to find a place to call home.

[From [url=https://cloverfirefly.itch.io/beyond-the-moon-behind-the-rain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在不远的未来，一种奇怪的疾病几乎毁灭了人类。感染者会变成没有意识、只知饥饿的空壳。

两个女孩结伴踏上旅途，寻找一个可以称为家的地方。

（来源：[url=https://cloverfirefly.itch.io/beyond-the-moon-behind-the-rain]itch.io[/url]）
